title: Cancellation of mixed-universe pullback along a retraction
statement: Let X,Y be schemes with independent derived localizations, and let i:X→Y and p:Y→X satisfy i followed by p = id_X. For every E in the specified D(X), the composite L i* L p* E using [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes] is isomorphic to E. No Noetherian, flatness, or properness assumption is required.

proof.text: Unfold the mixed-universe pullbacks. Apply the counit of the Y localization equivalence, map through the standard pullback of i and the inverse X equivalence. Apply the standard derived-pullback composition isomorphism at the image of E. Rewrite i followed by p as id_X and apply the identity comparison, then apply the inverse of the unit of the X equivalence. These are exactly the isomorphisms composed in the Lean proof.
